title: AudioPlayBackTrack in AnimationTrees (BlendSpace2D) muting everything
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in 4.5 Beta 3, Beta 4, Beta 5 and Godot 4.4.1 ### System information Window 10 ### Issue description I have a simple AnimationTree (BlendTree) with 2 BlendSpace2Ds (one for standing, one for crouching). The mesh of the player (humanoid) has animations for all directions in these two states. The BlendSpace allows for smooth transitions. The Animations themselves have AudioPlayBack calls for each step taken; the second step is longer than the animation itself. In the Editor itself the AnimationTree blends well with all the audio as expected. The AnimationPlayer also causes no issues whatsoever. The issues occur only in game and I am not sure how to reproduce it. In the game itself there are 3 more sound effects (an explosion, laser, and environmental sounds). The player also causes more sounds when crouching/standing up and when jumping/landing. Sometimes, running backwards and walking forwards work as expected but all other step sounds are silent. Other times the audio suddenly cuts out completely with the only way of recovery by pausing and unpausing the game. Sometimes this occurs quite early other times I struggle to cause this. ### Steps to reproduce Create a handful of animations with AudioPlayback keyframes. Create an AnimationTree (Blendtree as the root) and a large blendspace with the animations in there (4 direction close to the center, and 4 more to the edges of the blendspace). create a way to move through the blendspace in game and have fun without audio (or broken audio) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [mrp_audioplayback.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21507432/mrp_audioplayback.zip)
